pull_request.title: Documentation: current layout candidates and RZ overview
pull_request.head: codex/layout-main-page
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Adds a **current detector layout main page directly linked from README**, with a clickable R–Z preview leading to one concise feature table and the relevant decisions/PRs. The current candidate combines the tracker on main, proposed 3 T solenoid ([PR64](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/64)), detailed Si–W ECAL ([PR70](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/70) endcaps and [PR71](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/71) barrel), and a rough HCAL outline. FCal, the muon system and its magnets are explicitly absent.

The drawing combines pinned component bounds on equal radial/axial scales; it does not establish combined native geometry or engineering/performance acceptance. Each component's merged/open status is stated. AGENTS and a PR-template checkbox require future approved/merged layout changes to update the page, its links/status and drawing inputs.

## Change and validation

- Creates the Markdown candidate index, compact feature page and named source-bound drawing inputs; README provides both the main-page link and clickable image.
- Reuses recorded tracker sensitive bounds (45,646 planes), conditional solenoid allocations and ECAL/HCAL package envelopes. Both signs of z are shown; polygonal radii are apothems and detailed inactive gaps/passive tracker services are explicitly omitted.
- Generates SVG using the Python standard library; an existing rsvg-convert provides the PNG preview. No new packages or production geometry changes.
- Final checks:16 pinned source hashes,69 tracker input hashes,47 local Markdown links/images, valid XML, deterministic SVG reproduction and visual PNG inspection. Scientific project records,179 paired journals, token Pages build and staged whitespace checks pass.
- Exact current root/child token counters are unavailable and recorded as unknown. Historical observed totals are preserved.

This PR targets **main independently of PR64/70/71**; pending prototype descriptions are linked at immutable revisions. Merge metadata and selected layouts must be reconciled after subsequent approved changes merge; repository merge alone grants no scientific sign-off.

[Open the layout main page](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/a234dc2140bd70c9d2b058d12b372853a7d650ea/docs/layouts/README.md) · [Concise candidate features](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/a234dc2140bd70c9d2b058d12b372853a7d650ea/docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001-tracker-3t-siw.md).

[![Current candidate R–Z view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/a234dc2140bd70c9d2b058d12b372853a7d650ea/docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-001-rz.png)](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/a234dc2140bd70c9d2b058d12b372853a7d650ea/docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001-tracker-3t-siw.md)

Explicit generic role assignment; native profile loading not claimed. Workflow instructions from main 7c6d453fef12c3207b468c4fc99633fb393072a4.

```json
{
  "id": "LAYOUT-PubDoc",
  "role": "PubDoc",
  "input_revision": "7c6d453fef12c3207b468c4fc99633fb393072a4",
  "inputs": [
    "README.md",
    "AGENTS.md",
    "docs/design/DES-025-tracker-dd4hep-gen3.md",
    "docs/design/DES-029-calorimeter-assemblies.md",
    "project/tracking.json"
  ],
  "mode": "write",
  "writable_paths": [
    "README.md",
    "AGENTS.md",
    ".github/pull_request_template.md",
    "docs/layouts/README.md",
    "docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001-tracker-3t-siw.md",
    "docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001.json",
    "docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-001-rz.svg",
    "docs/layouts/figures/LAYOUT-001-rz.png",
    "tools/layout_overview/draw.py"
  ],
  "task": "Create the separately requested concise Markdown main page of current layout candidates accessible prominently from root README. One human-selected candidate: current tracker, inner3T solenoid (open PR64), SiW ECAL endcap(open PR70) and forthcoming detailed SiW barrel(PR71 requested; coordinator provides final URL), HCAL rough outline only, no FCal or muon system/muon magnets yet. Main page shows clickable RZ preview linking to a very concise feature page with decision/DES/PR links. Show both +/-z, real envelope scales, tracker (prefer actual recorded sensitive planes), distinguish current component geometry from conditional planning outlines and absent systems. Read extra exact sources with git show: solenoid4e44d7c650ac0a2931f7fc1637b5b3f2dfbe4c95 and edge sensors5664d16aea2df36222dc0099ba18594cf506304d; cite their revisions. You may inspect source files needed to obtain original plotted tracker planes, but do not claim new simulation. Preserve open status and no engineering sign-off. No new dependencies or packages. Standard-library SVG is allowed for this engineering drawing, or existing matplotlib if present. Record named geometry inputs and reproducible draw command in LAYOUT-001.json. Add durable future main-page maintenance rule to AGENTS and a focused PR-template checkbox: update candidate page/view/links when approved changes are merged into a layout prototype; merger alone grants no engineering sign-off. Do not conflate inherited ODD full-detector geometry with this selected candidate or show absent systems. Work only in this worktree. Do not commit, push, create PR, message tasks or start other agents.",
  "deliverable": "Owned Markdown/overview inputs and reproducible RZ drawing plus concise cited handoff, changes and actual checks to coordinator. Coordinator owns logging/project records/PR creation and fills PR71 exact link.",
  "completion": "All owned files coherent, sources/revisions pinned and statuses accurate; generated SVG inspected structurally and PNG visually if renderer available, documentation links checked. Clearly report unavailable rendering or source data instead of inventing dimensions."
}
```
